authored_assumptions: Original robot design without an image reference; all visible and hidden surfaces, proportions and mechanics are authored.
The biped has real independently weighted torso, upper arms, forearms, thighs and shins, with rigid toy-like joints rather than deforming soft skin.
Anatomical left is world +X and right is world -X for the -Y-facing rest pose.
Head, hands, feet and held-tool descendants are unbound rest transforms under the ten controlled body bones; no finger, visor or antenna actuation is inferred.
The workpiece and assembly probe are rigid held props. Probe strokes and inspection are gestures; no circuit simulation, generated marks or manufacturing occurs.
Weft retargeting uses the existing simulated body frames; authored clips are provenance and not alternate simulation actions.
Materials are explicitly opaque matte diffuse with metallic=0 and roughness=1. Gold is a paint color, not a metallic shader.
Keyframe rotations/translations use model rest axes and are converted through bone rest bases by the builder.
rest_pose: Authored default bone transforms. Blender Z-up/-Y-front exported to glTF Y-up/+Z-front.
